obligations.title: Your professional obligations
obligations.intro: In short, the code of conduct asks every licensed practitioner to:

items.honesty: Act honestly and in your client's best interest.
items.disclosure: Tell clients about any personal interest or conflict before you act.
items.clientMoney: Keep client money separate and account for every franc.
items.records: Keep clear records of every transaction and agreement.
items.scope: Work only within your category, authorised area and conditions.
items.training: Keep your knowledge up to date and renew your licence on time.

article10.title: Referral only (Article 10)
article10.intro: As a referral agent, your licence lets you introduce clients only. In plain language:

items.referOnly: Refer clients to a licensed agent, broker or firm — nothing more.
items.noNegotiation: Do not negotiate prices, terms or contracts for anyone.
items.noMoney: Do not take deposits or hold money for clients.
items.disclose: Tell the client who you are referring them to and any referral fee you receive.

g1.article10:
Article 10 — Real Estate Referral Agents

1. A Referral Agent may only introduce or refer prospective clients to a licensed practitioner or firm.
2. A Referral Agent may not negotiate terms, show or market property on their own account, hold client money, or sign or witness any agreement on behalf of a party.
3. A Referral Agent works under the supervision named in their licence and must disclose their referral role to every client.
4. Any referral fee is paid only through the supervising firm and must be recorded.
